Joint native B-spline mixed model with participant random slope and nested trial effects

etr_fit_joint_bspline_functional_nested_slope.Rd

Fits one native Gaussian functional mixed-effects model with an unstructured participant random intercept/slope B-spline coefficient covariance, separate unstructured trial random coefficient covariance, and optional per-trial AR(1) or physical-time exponential residual correlation.

Usage

etr_fit_joint_bspline_functional_nested_slope(
  trajectories, design, predictors, participant_column, trial_column,
  dimension, random_slope_predictor, residual_correlation = "iid",
  fixed_basis_size = 6L, random_basis_size = 4L,
  trial_random_basis_size = 4L, spline_degree = 3L,
  reml = TRUE, maxiter = 500L
)

Arguments

trajectories

Finite complete native trajectory collection on a common strictly increasing time grid.

design

Data frame with one unique curve_id per source curve.

predictors

Names of numeric fixed predictors including the random-slope predictor.

participant_column

Existing participant identifier in trajectory metadata.

trial_column

Distinct trial identifier in metadata: one curve per participant/trial pair.

dimension

Name of one response channel.

random_slope_predictor

Named numeric predictor that varies within every participant.

residual_correlation

One of "iid", "ar1", or "exponential". AR(1) requires regular spacing.

fixed_basis_size

Fixed-effect B-spline basis size (integer).

random_basis_size

Participant intercept/slope B-spline basis size (integer).

trial_random_basis_size

Nested trial B-spline basis size (integer).

spline_degree

Common B-spline degree, integer 1 through 5.

reml

If TRUE, restricted likelihood; otherwise maximum likelihood.

maxiter

At least 10 optimizer iterations.

Value

Also includes Python-shaped coefficient, participant/trial covariance, residual-correlation, conditional residual-whitening, and nested trial ID fields; the original native names remain available. The source optimizer bounds are diagnostic only and are not enforced by the native optimizer. The result also includes residual-correlation eigenvalues, condition number, source optimizer-bound diagnostics, grid regularity and interval, conditional whitened residual functions, and source-style trial ID aliases. These are diagnostic/representation additions, not revised fits. The returned object also includes source-aligned covariance eigenvalues, condition numbers, near-boundary and singularity flags for both random levels.

An etr_joint_bspline_mixed_nested_slope object inheriting etr_joint_bspline_mixed with coefficient functions and pointwise standard errors, participant and trial coefficient covariances, BLUP functions, conditional fitted and residual trajectories, within-trial serial covariance, and the nlme::lme fit.

Details

This is an additive bounded scientific native-R estimator with a preliminary participant-only identifiability fit. It does not claim Python 1.2 optimizer, result representation, error-contract, or complete scientific source parity. No new frozen Python source gap is closed by this implementation alone.
